name: The wall below the church of S. Francisco, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the wall below S. Francisco convent and church, Macau; above is the baroque pediment, flanked by urns, which overlooked the steps leading up to the church.  This church and convent were demolished in 1861 and replaced by the São Francisco barracks. For a view of the same feature see  E.163
